records.title: NASA Lunar Surface Technology — Surface Power
reported_facts: NASA describes VSAT as an autonomous deployment/retraction and mobility concept for uneven terrain using vertical arrays on masts up to 20 m.
NASA describes RFC storage as chemical storage, fuel-cell discharge and electrolysis recharge.
NASA describes LunaGrid-Lite as a tethered surface power distribution demonstration between a lander and rover.
NASA describes Harmonia as a radioisotope heat/power system intended to sustain operations through the 14-day lunar night and in permanently shadowed regions.
not_established: long-duration lunar RFC round-trip efficiency or life

records.title: NASA Calls for Proposals to Accelerate Lunar Surface Technologies
reported_facts: The solicitation identifies these technology capability areas for lunar South Pole infrastructure.

records.title: NASA Lunar Surface Technology — ISRU-Based Power on the Moon (Blue Alchemist)
reported_facts: NASA states Blue Origin's Blue Alchemist demonstrates integrated autonomous operation of eight technologies using regolith simulants in lunar environmental conditions.
NASA lists silicon solar cells, aluminium wires, oxygen, iron and slag among the process outputs.
not_established: solar-grade silicon yield and impurity distribution from public summary alone
complete factory imported mass and closure

records.title: NASA Small Spacecraft State of the Art — Power Subsystems
reported_facts: NASA describes the empirical spacecraft mission array population as clustering around approximately 30 W/kg, with an observed dataset envelope of approximately 1 to 200 W/kg.
NASA lists individual SmallSat array products with different specific-power and BOL output values, including flexible PV blankets and deployable rigid arrays.
not_established: storage, cabling, radiators or maintenance mass

records.title: Autonomous closed-loop framework for reproducible perovskite solar cells
reported_facts: Certified MPPT efficiency of 27.18% for 0.05 cm2 cells.
23.49% PCE for 21.4 cm2 mini-modules.
98.7% retention of initial efficiency after 1,200 hours under ISOS-L-1I.
The paper reports nearly fivefold greater efficiency reproducibility than manual fabrication.

records.title: Lunar surface energy infrastructure: from in-situ resource utilization to deep space exploration
reported_facts: Reviews planar, tent, triangular and vertical array concepts.
Discusses piezoelectric vibration-based non-contact dust removal.
Discusses PV/T and deep-space radiative cooling concepts.
Discusses CSP trough and linear Fresnel collectors, thermal storage and power-cycle options.
Reports literature values for radiation response and storage specific energy; these are secondary synthesis and must be traced to cited primary sources.
Provides a first-order lifecycle and launched-mass architecture comparison.
not_established: lunar field qualification of review concepts
long-duration RFC operation under lunar conditions
all cited study metrics being directly comparable

records.title: PV Fleet Performance Data Initiative
records.publisher: National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), U.S. Department of Energy
reported_facts: The initiative pools large PV plant operating data for fleet-level performance and degradation analysis.

The participation description specifies systems above 250 kW, at least three years of data, at least 15-minute performance sampling, on-site plane-of-array irradiance, meteorology and system specifications.
not_established: direct comparison with laboratory accelerated aging

records.title: NASA Carbothermal Reduction Demonstration
reported_facts: NASA reports thermal-vacuum prototype testing of a concentrated-solar carbothermal reactor using regolith simulant and carbon monoxide production.

records.title: Government Reference Design of the Vertical Solar Array Technology Demonstrator
reported_facts: The original reference concept specifies at least 10 kW capability and at least 10 m elevation from the lunar surface to the array bottom.
The cited concept describes approximately 6 m by 6 m total array geometry divided across two arrays on either side of a mast.

records.title: NASA FY2025 SBIR Phase I — Second-generation modular 50-kW lunar vertical solar array subtopic
reported_facts: The solicitation frames a second-generation modular 50-kW vertical array near the lunar South Pole.
The stated specific-power goal is greater than 75 W/kg.
The solicitation emphasizes compact packaging, safe transportation, reliable deployment, stable operation while Sun tracking, and occasional retraction and relocation.

records.title: Engineering Design Study of Laser Power Beaming for Applications on the Moon
reported_facts: The surface-to-surface concept uses a VSAT-style 10-m mast and studies up to 10-km receiver distance.
The design requirement is 300 W continuous usable power, a five-year design life and total landed mass below 625 kg.
The study reports approximately 1,595 W optical beam output, 542 W incident on the receiver PV array and 300 W usable at the load, with 242 W routed to receiver batteries.
The study describes beam operation for approximately 57% of the time and idle periods when the VSAT itself is shadowed.
not_established: generic 300-W service availability at arbitrary terrain locations

records.title: Cost-driven strategies towards industrially manufacturable perovskite photovoltaics
reported_facts: The review discusses perovskite manufacturing costs of approximately US$0.3–0.6/W versus approximately US$0.1/W for mature crystalline silicon in its assessed context.
It identifies yield, process/material reliability, material cost, recycling and simpler fabrication as key industrialization levers.
not_established: identical currency-year and accounting boundary across all manufacturers

records.title: Taking perovskite photovoltaics from promise to product
reported_facts: The perspective argues that laboratory efficiency gains have diminishing deployment value without scale-up, yield, operational stability, standards and factory-economics improvements.
not_established: a specific universal efficiency or cost target
independently measured factory yield for every technology
